entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support, you're speaking with Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-881-92B.

Certainly. Let me just pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't fit. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks. They just give me terrible blisters after a few miles. I need a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that; comfort is key. I see the order was delivered about 75 days ago. Just one moment while I confirm the return eligibility for you.
Just tell me yes or no.
Yes, absolutely. These cycling shoes are a standard item and fall well within our 90-day return policy. I can process this for you right now.
Good. So what do I do?

I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email on your account. And since you're a VIP member, I've waived the restocking fee and added a $20 credit to your account for the inconvenience. You can expect your full refund to your original payment method once the warehouse processes the return.
Okay, that's fine. I'll look for the email. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
